symptom: Empty POS desk stills (54001/54002 and retry +100) always seat a standing hologram card in the slot despite prompt saying hologram-silver card not inserted
root_cause: Krea2 Turbo treats mentioned objects as present; not inserted is ignored when hologram card is in the positive paragraph
fix: Empty location POS prompt must omit the card noun. Paper tongue + empty mouth-slot only. Card is a separate prop plate
prevention: For empty location masters, do not name props that must be absent. Krea has no reliable negation. Search card_insert before POS empty-slot gen.
